claims.statement: The fragment limits REST Checks write capability to GitHub Apps; OAuth Apps and authenticated users can view runs/suites but not create them in its stated context. Commit statuses are a suggested alternative, not equivalent check-suite authority or evidence of substantive tests. Exact credential type and endpoint permissions require separate operational verification.

Revoking all OAuth App permissions deletes SSH keys that App generated for the user, including generated deploy keys. Preserve generated-key scope rather than asserting every user key is deleted; revocation requires dependency/recovery planning and is not authorized by reading this warning.
